name: TeamSkeet
summary: High-output Miami studio network spanning dozens of youth-oriented and taboo-comedy series (Family Strokes, Sis Loves Me, Shoplyfter, Black Valley Girls).
ranking_rationale: Prolific network with strong scouting of rising talent and high release cadence across 30+ sub-sites, though heavily reliant on repetitive step-family tropes.

pricing.notes: Varies by plan and promo; check official checkout.

pros: Frequent weekly updates across 30+ distinct series
Consistently scouts rising performers early in their careers
Modern member site with fast streaming and downloads
cons: Heavy dependence on repetitive step-family fantasy premises
Checkout pushes bundle upsells and promotional auto-renewals
Less cinematic polish than Vixen Media Group studios

facts.value: Founded 2009 in Miami; operated by Paper Street Media
30+ active series with steady casting of rising performers
